h1: Every period in life has a first day. Be in it.
lead: START is Care Direct's family of programs for the moments people begin something new: a first baby, a first school day, university, a wedding, retirement. We put your product in their hands, with a guide they keep and a follow-up that turns trial into a relationship.

how.h2: Trial in their hands. A guide they keep. A follow-up that lasts.
steps: Your product, delivered at the moment of need through clinics, schools and universities. Real trial, not an impression.
A guide with every box — print, digital, or web, depending on the audience. Your brand earns a useful place, not just an ad slot.
Opt-in, GDPR-compliant registration collects email, phone, mobile and address — then we continue the conversation on the channels that fit each market.
Care Direct's in-house online communities keep the audience close and roll them into the next START.
